say:1:1610813001:1.text: Everyone, keep it down. I've got news to share.
say:1:1610813001:1.source_cn: 各位，小声点，我有个消息要和大家分享。

say:3:1610813002:1.text: What's up? Did you find something?
say:3:1610813002:1.source_cn: 怎么了，格墨文，你有什么发现？

say:4:1610813003:1.text: I don't know the full details of the exam, but a friend told me it favors acting alone rather than in teams.
say:4:1610813003:1.source_cn: 虽然不知道考试的内容，但据我一位朋友所说，这场考试单独...

say:7:1610813005:1.text: Yeah. My friend who serves the prince overheard him say this test was designed for individuals.
say:7:1610813005:1.source_cn: 嗯，我那位朋友是王子的近侍，他无意中听王子殿下说这次的...

say:8:1610813006:1.text: He sent me a message last night, and I figured I should share it. At least that way it's fair.
say:8:1610813006:1.source_cn: 他昨晚派人传信，将这个消息告诉了我。我觉得应该把这个消...

say:10:1610813007:1.text: Why give away your advantage? You'd benefit more by keeping quiet.
say:10:1610813007:1.source_cn: 为什么要把这么重要的信息告诉我们？闭口不言对你更有利。

say:11:1610813008:1.text: We've all worked too hard to get here. Winning because of inside information doesn't feel right.
say:11:1610813008:1.source_cn: 我们每个人走到这一步都很不容易，不该因为这一点信息差造...

say:12:1610813009:1.text: I'm confident in my magic—I don't need this kind of edge.
say:12:1610813009:1.source_cn: 说实话，我并不算无私。但这次我和大家分享这个消息，是因...

say:13:1610813010:1.text: And besides, it goes against everything my family stands for.
say:13:1610813010:1.source_cn: 所以我不愿意用这样的信息差来为自己增加胜算，更何况，这...

say:14:1610813011:1.text: Ha! That's so like you, Gervan.
say:14:1610813011:1.source_cn: 哈，格墨文，这还真是你的作风。

say:18:1610813013:1.text: Well, if that's the case, let's split up. May the best mage stand out!
say:18:1610813013:1.source_cn: 既然如此，我们就各自行动吧。各凭本事，看看谁能从这场选...

say:19:1610813014:1.source_cn: 好，希望我们都能考试顺利！

say:21:1610813015:1.text: People begin drifting off, but Cassadee hangs back, saying she'd rather team up with you than rely on the solo advantage.
say:21:1610813015:1.source_cn: 大家纷纷独自离开，但科丝蒂却留了下来，比起所谓的“单人...
say:21:1610813015:1.male: People begin drifting off, but Cassadee hangs back, saying she'd rather team up with you than rely on the solo advantage.
say:21:1610813015:1.female: People begin drifting off, but Cassadee hangs back, saying she'd rather team up with you than rely on the solo advantage.

say:22:1610813016:1.text: You agree to partner with her and head off to find Professor Hepler.
say:22:1610813016:1.source_cn: 你答应了科丝蒂的请求，和她一起离开，准备去不远处找赫普老师。
say:22:1610813016:1.male: You agree to partner with her and head off to find Professor Hepler.
say:22:1610813016:1.female: You agree to partner with her and head off to find Professor Hepler.
